endpoints.name: Get Apps
endpoints.description: Returns a list of apps from My Apps in Orchestrate.

queryParams.name: q
queryParams.description: Pass a value for q to search for apps matching the query string.

queryParams.name: ordering
queryParams.description: Use `ordering=title` to sort by title or `ordering=modified_at` to sort by the last update date. Add `-` before the parameter to sort in descending order.

queryParams.name: page
queryParams.description: Pass the page number to retrieve the apps list.

queryParams.name: page_size
queryParams.description: Pass the number of items to retrieve per page.

queryParams.name: created_by
queryParams.description: Pass the user ID to retrieve a list of the apps created by a user.

queryParams.name: app_type
queryParams.description: Pass `READY_TO_USE` to list active apps, `IN_PROGRESS` to list the inactive apps, and `INSTALLED` to retrieve apps that are installed.

queryParams.name: categories
queryParams.description: Pass the categories to filter apps.

queryParams.name: is_system
queryParams.description: Pass false to retrieve custom apps or true to retrieve apps.

queryParams.name: is_configured
queryParams.description: Pass true to get configured apps or false to get non-configured apps.

queryParams.name: lite_enabled
queryParams.description: Pass true to retrieve agent-compatible apps or false to fetch apps that are not agent-compatible.

queryParams.name: created_at
queryParams.description: Pass the `created_at` value to filter apps created in the last week, month, or year.

queryParams.name: created_at__gte
queryParams.description: Pass the start time in Unix time format. The list of apps created after the entered time will be returned. Example: *1655145000*.

queryParams.name: created_at__lte
queryParams.description: Pass the end time in Unix time format. The list of apps created before the entered time will be returned. Example: *1642530599*.

endpoints.name: Get App Details
endpoints.description: Returns the details of a specific app.

pathParams.name: app_unique_id
pathParams.description:
Enter the unique ID of the app to retrieve its details.
You can retrieve the unique IDs of apps using the **Get Apps** endpoint.

endpoints.name: Get App Instances
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of available instances for all apps. To retrieve instances of a specific app, pass the unique ID of the app.

queryParams.name: page
queryParams.description: Pass the page number to retrieve the app details.

queryParams.name: page_size
queryParams.description: Pass the number of records to display per page.

queryParams.name: app_unique_id
queryParams.description:
Pass the app unique ID to retrieve the instances of the app. You can retrieve the unique ID of an app using the **Get Apps** endpoint. 
If the app ID is not passed, all available instances will be retrieved.

endpoints.name: Create App Instance

endpoints.name: Get App Instance Details

pathParams.name: instance_id

Pass the unique ID of the instance to retrieve details of the app instance. 
Example: *d6a03423-52fd-479b-a79d-85102e53861*.
You can retrieve the instance ID using the **Get App Instances** endpoint.

endpoints.name: Test App Instance Connectivity

pathParams.name: instance_id

Enter the unique ID of the instance to test the connectivity. 
Example: *d6a03423-52fd-479b-a79d-85102e53861f*.

endpoints.name: Get App Actions
endpoints.description: Returns a list of all available actions from all apps. To retrieve actions of a specific app, pass the Unique ID of the app.

queryParams.name: app_unique_id
queryParams.description: Pass the unique ID of the app to retrieve the list of actions. Example: *f8f6af0e-35c8-48e3-8cda-d0fe61476441*. You can retrieve the unique ID of an app using the **Get Apps** endpoint.

queryParams.name: page

queryParams.name: page_size

endpoints.name: Get Action Details

pathParams.name: action_id

Pass the unique ID of the action to retrieve the action details. 
Example: *52091b28-5daa-42f3-9eb9-926994a91ca5*.

endpoints.name: Execute Action
endpoints.description: Execute an app action by passing the required parameters in the payload.

endpoints.name: Download App Package
endpoints.description: Download the app's ZIP file by entering the app identifier. You can save the response as a ZIP file to your device.

pathParams.name: app_slug

Example: *abuse_ipdb_1_1_0*.

endpoints.name: Get Playbooks

queryParams.name: page_size
queryParams.description: Pass the number of items to retrieve per page.

queryParams.name: scheduled

queryParams.name: labels

queryParams.name: tags

queryParams.name: actions

queryParams.name: is_active

queryParams.name: modified

queryParams.name: page_size

queryParams.name: scheduled

queryParams.name: tags
queryParams.description: Pass the unique ID of the tags to retrieve playbooks.

queryParams.name: labels
queryParams.description: Pass the label name to retrieve playbooks.

queryParams.name: apps
queryParams.description: Pass the app identifier. You can retrieve the app identifier using the **Get Apps** endpoint.

queryParams.name: actions
queryParams.description: Pass the action identifier of an action. You can retrieve the action identifier using the **Get App Actions** endpoint.

queryParams.name: is_active
queryParams.description: Pass true to filter active playbooks, else false.

queryParams.name: modified
queryParams.description: Pass the last modified value to filter playbooks based on their last modified time.

endpoints.name: Get Playbook Result
endpoints.description: Returns the playbook runlogs based on the unique ID of the playbook. If no payload is passed, it returns the complete list of playbook run logs.

queryParams.name: page
queryParams.description: Pass the page number to retrieve the playbook result.

queryParams.name: page_size
queryParams.description: Pass the number of items to retrieve per page.

queryParams.name: playbook
queryParams.description: Pass the playbook's unique ID. You can retrieve unique IDs of playbooks using the **Get Playbooks** endoint.

endpoints.name: Get Playbook Run Logs
endpoints.description: Retrieves the list of playbook run logs along with the associated playbook data.

queryParams.name: page
queryParams.description: Pass the page number to retrieve the playbook run logs

queryParams.name: page_size
queryParams.description: Pass the number of items to retrieve per page.

queryParams.name: playbook_status
queryParams.description: Pass the status of the playbook to retrieve the run logs.

queryParams.name: status
queryParams.description: Pass the playbook run status to filter playbooks.

queryParams.name: source_playbook_result__is_null
queryParams.description: Pass true or false to filter playbooks based on the master playbook.

queryParams.name: apps_list
queryParams.description: Pass the unique ID of the app. You can retrieve the unique ID of an app using the **Get Apps** endpoint.

queryParams.name: playbook
queryParams.description: Pass the unique ID of the playbook. You can retrieve the unique ID of a playbook using the **Get Playbooks** endpoint.

queryParams.name: actions_list
queryParams.description: Pass the unique ID of the app action. You can retrieve the unique ID of an action using the **Get App Actions** endpoint.

queryParams.name: ran_by
queryParams.description: Pass the unique ID of the user who initiated the playbook run.

queryParams.name: scheduled
queryParams.description: Pass true to retrieve scheduled playbooks run logs, else false.

queryParams.name: run_at
queryParams.description: Pass the date to retrieve playbooks based on the playbook last run.

queryParams.name: run_at__lte
queryParams.description: Pass the end time in Unix time format to retrieve the playbook run logs.

queryParams.name: run_at__gte
queryParams.description: Pass the start time in Unix time format to retrieve the playbook run logs.

queryParams.name: ordering
queryParams.description: Pass the ordering values, such as `modified`, `execution_time`, and `created` to filter playbooks.
